row:
The first Veterinary Rehabilitation mobile unit in UK going on line.
We are here to spread the world about the importance of physical rehabilitation and multimodal approach in the small animals.

Pets are members of our families and their wellbeing is THE essential aim of our job and daily care. Our services are created to deliver the best cares for every kind of condition requiring physical therapies and are specifically designed around the patient as every patient is UNIQUE!
